liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Around tease and Jam** (2 other sources): A clear Around and Around tease emerges out of Wharf Rat; Contains an Around and Around tease after Wharf Rat [1][3]
- **Loser** (1 review): Reviewer says Jerry flubbed this song [11]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Reviewer praises the Scarlet-Fire pairing as great within a strong second set [12]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Reviewer calls it a high-energy, blazing highlight [17]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Lyrics were botched, though the guitar filler was nice [17]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Playin' run into Johnny B. Goode the best part of the show [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **Around tease and Jam**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-10-24.151424.sbd.gems.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 156 min [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader says this transfer sounds really good, the first complete soundboard shnid from the same masters [1]
- **gd79-10-24.rolfe.vernon-pujol.19589.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 151 min; rated 3.33/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found this audience recording's sound terrible and gave up on the first set; More balanced than the other source, with more bass; audio improves after the first few songs; Reviewer says it captures what being there was like, with a somewhat heavy crowd presence at points [10][15][18]
- **gd1979-10-24.152429.senn.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 149 min [3]
- **gd1979-10-24.145373.fob.nak700.rolfe.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 151 min [5]
- **gd79-10-24.senn.munder.13298.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 145 min; rated 3.57/5 by 7 [7]. Said about its sound: Low-generation and clear, but heavy midrange makes it painful at higher volume; still listenable, with a roaring crowd; Reviewer considers it a very nice sounding audience tape [11][12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer found the band low on energy, though the crowd was into it; it was their fifth show [13]
- Reviewer notes good band energy and an enthusiastic crowd [15]
- Reviewer notes this was Brent Mydland's first full East Coast tour, and he fit in well [20]
- Reviewer points listeners to the 10/27/79 show as far better [10]
- Reviewer says it opened a great tour but falls short of Cape Cod, Nassau and Veteran's Memorial shows [12]
- Reviewer found Providence 11/3/79 equally weak, though Alabama Getaway turned up there [13]
- Reviewer rates this night just okay, below the MSG run and the hot New Haven show the next night [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-10-24.151424.sbd.gems.flac16**: transferred by Speed Corrections by Jason Chastain Mastering by Jamie Waddell with assistance from Jim Blackwood Track, FLAC and Pack by Steve Gravel; source: Master Soundboard Cassettes > DAT [1]. Also: Soundboard transfer patched with Steve Rolfe's Nakamichi 700 audience tape at Mama Tried's start, part of Sailor>Saint, and Terrapin [1]
- **gd79-10-24.rolfe.vernon-pujol.19589.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Steve Rolfe; source: Audience Recording: Sony D5 w/ nak 700's [2]. Also: Taped by Steve Rolfe, described as a top taper using the best microphones of the era; Recorded by Steve Rolfe with Sony D5 and Nakamichi 700 microphones; Chain: audience master cassette to DAT by David Minor, WAV by Marc Pujol, SHN by Matt Vernon [2][18]
- **gd1979-10-24.152429.senn.blend.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston; source: Rob Eaton's Master Audience Cassettes; (2) Sennheiser 441 (left + right) + (1) Sennheiser 421 (center) blend > Nakamichi 550 [3]. Also: Rob Eaton's recording, with a 1:05 Steve Rolfe Nakamichi 700 patch in the Drums>Space transition [3]
- **gd1979-10-24.145373.fob.nak700.rolfe.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Steve Rolfe; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Steve Rolfe's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 [5]. Also: Patches: 12 seconds in Fire On The Mountain from the Sennheiser blend, 8 seconds in Drums>Space from a soundboard [5]
- **gd79-10-24.senn.munder.13298.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1979-10-24 Wed Springfield Civic Center Arena, Springfield, MA](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1419669453084/grateful-dead-1979-10-24-wed-springfield) [23]
